decisions.reason: The gallery tab and secondary-content changes do not alter the separate requirement to associate relevant images with services.
Changing gallery categories and organization does not change whether gallery items require hover animations.
The specified gallery categories remain consistent with, but do not modify, the sitewide visual-emphasis requirement.
The gallery organization decision does not alter the homepage design direction, hero image emphasis, or overlay settings.
Gallery tabs and secondary gallery content do not alter the itemized service-pricing layout or transparency rules.
The gallery organization decision has no effect on the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
The gallery category change does not alter the required number or presentation of package-pricing boxes.
The source decision concerns main-gallery categories and secondary content, not the animation level of the homepage gallery.
Gallery categories do not change the deferred calculator's service-selection, pricing, bundle, or surcharge behavior.
The gallery organization decision does not alter the pricing-area navigation entry or its destination.
